mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 1.0% (as of the decision date) signals accommodative monetary policy, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in unemployment rate above 5.0% signals economic distress, triggering a flight to safety and negative S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate a weakening labor market and manufacturing sector, causing negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns as corporate earnings growth slows.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both INDPRO and UNRATE decline.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 0.25 percentage points signals a monetary tightening cycle, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises by more than 0.25pp over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts (HOUST > 900k) signal robust consumer demand and economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns through elevated corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST exceeds 900k.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 99.0 (index 2017=100) indicates manufacturing contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns as investors anticipate reduced corporate profits.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 99.0.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signal broad-based weakness in consumer demand, resulting in negative S&P 500 60-day forward returns due to reduced spending and economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST decline.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions (GDPC1 > 15800), the S&P 500 tends to underperform in the short term (5 days) due to profit-taking and rising interest rate expectations, leading to negative forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 exceeds 15800.
